title: The Choice of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: "The moment Chen Ji's words fell, the Tianji Record in his sleeve burst forth with dazzling golden light, four entirely different paths manifesting simultaneously in the void—Freedom, Chess Master, Destruction, Fusion—and he must immediately step onto one, otherwise time runs out and everything returns to zero."

text.content: "The aftershocks of the Three Realms' barrier collapse had yet to dissipate, grayish-white chaotic mist filling the world. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, the torn page of the Tianji Record in his sleeve trembling violently in a way never seen before, as if it would burn his entire arm to a crisp. 'This warning intensity...' He gritted his teeth, veins bulging at his temples, 'is a sensation I have never experienced since obtaining the Tianji Record.'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao's figure swept to his side like a startled swan goose, the ice-blue Inner Sect token in her palm emitting a faint glow, yet appearing so fragile at this moment. She crouched down, cupping Chen Ji's ice-cold wrist with both hands, her usually cold and aloof beautiful eyes actually glistening with a thin veil of tears. 'Whatever you choose, I will stay with you. This is my decision, not your burden.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, meeting those tear-filled eyes directly. This man who had always walked the world under the persona of atrash, never revealing true feelings before others, felt a piece of ice in his heart shatter quietly. 'Qingyao...' His voice was somewhat hoarse, 'Do you know what this means? The path I choose may plunge you into eternal perdition.'"

dialogue.content: "So what?" Su Qingyao smiled softly, that smile carrying a complex emotion woven with resolve and tenderness. She extended her slender fingers, gently wiping the sweat from Chen Ji's temple. 'Did you think these three years of my endless approach to the truth, only to have you dissolve it again and again, were wasted effort? I decided long ago—even if you are the greatest con artist in this world, I'll accept it.'"

text.content: "Just then, a幽purple light suddenly blazed. Ye Qing's figure emerged from the mist, her body surrounded by eerie Demonic Path fog, yet she herself swayed like a candle about to extinguish. 'Chen Ji, I have bought you the final ten breaths of time.' Her voice was cold as frost, 'My Observer's power... has been entirely sacrificed.'"

"Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He saw black patterns spreading beneath Ye Qing's feet, the Demonic Path fog suppressed by the Holy Sect for years surging out madly, transforming into a barrier that concealed the Tianji Record's aura. But this price... was her Observer's power, the foundation of her existence in this world. 'Ye Qing, you...'"

dialogue.content: "Don't look at me like that.' Ye Qing slightly raised her chin, the corner of her mouth curving into a mocking arc, yet that mockery was not directed at Chen Ji, but at herself. 'Did you think I cooperated with you because of that prophecy? Ridiculous—I simply refuse to be anyone's chess piece anymore. The Holy Sect used me as a chess piece, the Eyes of Heavenly Dao used me as a chess piece, only you... treated me as a person.'"

text.content: "Before the words finished, Ye Qing's body began to turn transparent, like thin ice melting under the scorching sun. Yet she laughed more and more brilliantly, pointing toward the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's sleeve: 'Go, make your choice. After ten breaths, when the mist dissipates, the Eyes of Heavenly Dao will lock onto your position.' She paused, her voice dropping, 'Don't let me... regret believing in you.'"

"Chen Ji slowly stood up, Su Qingyao standing shoulder to shoulder with him without hesitation. He surveyed his surroundings—within the chaotic mist, countless gazes were piercing through the void to watch him. Ling Yuan Old Sect Master's conspiracy, Han Lie's overbearing manner, the Holy Sect's ambitions, Mo Xiansheng's mysteries... everything converged before him at this moment."

choice.prompt: "At the crossroads of destiny, four paths manifested before Chen Ji, and he must make his choice within ten breaths—"

choices.description: "Shake off the control of the Tianji Record and the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, seek transcendence with a fragmented body, retire with Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and others. The price is abandoning the possibility of changing the world, but all who matter to him will be preserved."
choices.visible_cost: "Lose the chance for complete evolution of the Tianji Record, may be hunted by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain truly free love with Su Qingyao, Ye Qing's sacrifice will not be in vain"
choices.risk_hint: "The Eyes of Heavenly Dao will not easily spare those who know the truth"

text.content: "Chen Ji looked at Su Qingyao, then at the dissipating Ye Qing, finally settling his gaze on that page of scorching Tianji Record. He softly said: 'If my existence itself is a threat to you all, then I would rather abandon this power.'"

choices.description: "Accept the complete inheritance of the Tianji Record, officially become the opponent of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, play the role of a chess master to scheme across the world, manipulate all forces at will. This is the path Chen Ji is most adept at, yet also the loneliest."
choices.visible_cost: "Must constantly consume Heavenly Fate Value, lifespan greatly reduced, may lose Su Qingyao's trust"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain the ability to completely control the Tianji Record, become a true Chess Master"
choices.risk_hint: "The Eyes of Heavenly Dao will accelerate the chess game, allies by your side may become discarded pieces"

text.content: "Chen Ji's gaze suddenly deepened like an abyss, that sharpness of a true chess master awakened by the Tianji Record. 'Since Heavenly Dao wants to play this game, I'll play it to the end.' He coldly said, 'It's just—who is the piece, who is the chess master, remains to be seen.'"

choices.description: "Use the Tianji Record as a medium to release the sealed ultimate power, destroying everything including the Eyes of Heavenly Dao. The price is Chen Ji himself will also turn to nothingness, but at least can take all enemies along."
choices.visible_reward: "Completely shatter the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's layout, no more manipulators of prophecies in the world"
choices.risk_hint: "Ye Qing's sacrifice becomes meaningless, everyone dies"

text.content: "Chen Ji lowered his head to look at the Tianji Record in his palm, murmuring: 'If my existence is destined to be manipulated by fate... then let it all turn to nothingness with me.' His voice carried resolve, yet a barely perceptible tremor."

choices.description: "Completely fuse the Tianji Record with himself, neither entirely subject to the Eyes of Heavenly Dao nor confronting it directly, but opening a third path—coexisting with Heavenly Dao, reshaping the order of the Three Realms as a collaborator."
choices.visible_cost: "Must bear part of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's will, may gradually lose humanity"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain qualification to dialogue with Heavenly Dao, fundamentally change the rules of the game"
choices.risk_hint: "The Eyes of Heavenly Dao may erode Chen Ji's consciousness during fusion"

text.content: "Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed softly: 'The Eyes of Heavenly Dao wants to use me as a chess piece? Fine, then I'll be a chess piece it has never seen—one that moves on its own.' He looked up at the sky, eyes glinting with cunning, 'Since it wants to play chess, I'll enter the game.'"

"The ten breaths of time passed in an instant. Ye Qing's figure had faded to near invisibility, only those 幽purple eyes still死死盯着 Chen Ji. 'Time... has come...' Her voice was like a candle in the wind,，随时可能熄灭，'Chen Ji... make your choice...'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao suddenly gripped his hand tighter, the warmth from her palm causing Chen Ji's heart to jolt. She had never lost composure like this, the ice-mountain Inner Disciple Senior Fellow now had red-rimmed eyes, lips slightly trembling. 'Whatever you choose... I'm here. Even if you descend to hell, I'll go with you.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, gripping Su Qingyao's hand even tighter. He turned to look at that page of Tianji Record fragment floating in the air, at the constantly flickering characters upon it—the will of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, awaiting his response. Pressure from all directions pressed in like physical substance, yet the light in his eyes grew increasingly clear."

"Ye Qing was right, she can no longer be a chess piece.' Chen Ji spoke slowly, his voice not loud yet clearly transmitting throughout the chaotic space. 'Su Qingyao is also right, she chose me.' He raised his head, facing the gaze from somewhere in the void, 'And I... Chen Ji, from this day forward, will no longer be anyone's chess piece.'"

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji's declaration echoed through the collapsing heavens and earth, the light of the four paths growing ever stronger—"

choices.description: "Carrying the will of Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, abandon the Tianji Record's power, choose a path不被人操控"
choices.visible_cost: "Lose all abilities and schemes already obtained"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain a true home with Su Qingyao, Ye Qing's death gains meaning"
choices.risk_hint: "May be hunted, rest of life without peace"

text.content: "Chen Ji fiercely threw the Tianji Record fragment into the void, that torn ancient book let out a mournful cry and dissolved into scattered golden light. He turned, tightly embracing the tearful Su Qingyao: 'Let's go.'"

choices.description: "Accept the complete inheritance of the Tianji Record, become a true Chess Master, turn the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's layout back against it"
choices.visible_cost: "Lifespan halved, must constantly consume Heavenly Fate Value to maintain power"
choices.visible_reward: "Become an existence that can threaten the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, evolve from chess piece to chess master"
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao may be unable to accept this path's choice"

text.content: "Chen Ji grabbed the Tianji Record fragment, golden light pouring into his body, his eyes instantly turning pure gold. 'From this day forward,' his voice became majestic and foreign, 'I am the Chess Master.'"

choices.description: "Use himself as a medium to detonate the Tianji Record's power, perish together with the Eyes of Heavenly Dao"
choices.visible_reward: "The Eyes of Heavenly Dao suffers severe damage, the Three Realms gain breathing room"
choices.risk_hint: "Both Su Qingyao and Ye Qing's sacrifices become meaningless"

text.content: "Chen Ji laughed long and uproariously at the sky, that laughter carrying infinite desolation and resolve: 'Since this world wants me to be a chess piece, I'll smash the chessboard along with it!' He spread his arms wide, the Tianji Record's light beginning to expand madly..."

choices.description: "Become one with the Tianji Record, become an existence transcending humans and gods, create new order"
choices.visible_reward: "Become an existence that can change the rules, completely escape the fate of a chess piece"
choices.risk_hint: "May completely lose self during the process"

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his eyes, proactively facing that page of Tianji Record. Golden light merged with the power within him, his body beginning to turn semi-transparent, countless ancient runes appearing on his skin. 'Heavenly Dao...' he whispered, 'let us fuse.'"

"The moment Chen Ji's words fell, the Tianji Record in his sleeve burst forth with dazzling golden light. 'BOOM—' The entire chaotic space violently trembled, four entirely different paths manifesting simultaneously in the void: the Path of Freedom emanated soft white light, the Path of the Chess Master flickered with sharp golden radiance, the Path of Destruction burned with crimson flames, and the Path of Fusion flowed with deep purple-gold hues."

"Four paths manifesting simultaneously—this is an unprecedented omen!' Mo Xiansheng's aged voice drifted from the void, carrying unprecedented gravity, 'Chen Ji, do you know what this means?' Chen Ji stood at the intersection of the four paths, behind him Su Qingyao's gaze intertwined with anticipation and fear, before him the final gaze of the dissipating Ye Qing."

dialogue.content: "Child, whichever path you choose, remember—' Mo Xiansheng's voice gradually drifted away, 'The true secret of the Tianji Record lies not in the magnitude of power, but in...' The words abruptly stopped, as if some force forcibly severed his transmission."

text.content: "Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings, looking at the four paths, at Su Qingyao's tear-filled eyes, at Ye Qing's dissipating form. The corner of his mouth suddenly curved—that familiar smile, the one that appeared only when playing the pig to eat the tiger. 'Interesting,' he murmured to himself, 'Four paths all demanding my choice? Then I'll偏偏走出一条只属于我自己的路.'"

"He took a step, neither toward the Path of Freedom, nor the Path of the Chess Master, nor Destruction or Fusion—but directly stepped into the exact center where the four paths converged. 'Eyes of Heavenly Dao,' Chen Ji's voice echoed through the chaos, carrying an air of looking down upon all under heaven, 'You wanted to see my choice, didn't you? Then open your eyes wide and watch—my choice, is the path of making no choice!' The words fell, the light from the four paths surged violently, and the Tianji Record's reaction was a thousand times more intense than ever before..."
